title_en: Fall 2026 Integrated Master's-Doctoral Program: Relinquishment or Continuation Form Submission
summary: Integrated master's-doctoral program students for whom Fall 2026 is their second semester (for example, March 2026 entrants) must submit either a Relinquishment Form (포기원) or a Continuation Form (지속원) between 15 September 2026 and 17:00 on 11 December 2026. Students in their fourth semester or later who wish to complete the master's program in February 2027 must submit a Relinquishment Form by the morning of 23 September 2026. Forms must carry the student's own signature and the advisor's signature or seal, and must be submitted to the department office, Building 301, Room 319.
applies_to: Mandatory for students in the integrated master's-doctoral program for whom Fall 2026 is their second semester (for example, students admitted in March 2026). Also applies to integrated program students in their fourth semester or later who wish to complete the master's program in February 2027 (they must submit a Relinquishment Form), and to students of earlier admission years who have already submitted a Continuation Form but now wish to receive only a master's degree (they must submit a Relinquishment Form according to this schedule).

dates.what: Submission period for the Relinquishment Form or Continuation Form (second-semester integrated program students)
Deadline for the Relinquishment Form for students in their fourth semester or later who wish to complete the master's program in February 2027
Doctoral qualifying examination for students who submit a Continuation Form (must meet eligibility requirements and take the examination)
dates.when: At the beginning of the third semester

conditions: Integrated program students admitted in 2015 or later must take the qualifying examination for thesis submission in their third semester, so they must submit a Relinquishment or Continuation Form in their second semester.

Students who wish to complete the master's program should submit the Relinquishment Form no later than the semester before the semester of intended completion, to avoid problems with their academic record.
Students of earlier admission years who already submitted a Continuation Form but wish to receive only a master's degree must submit a Relinquishment Form according to this schedule.
Submitting a Relinquishment Form changes the student's status to the master's program, and changing back to the integrated master's-doctoral program later is not possible.
The student's own signature on the form is mandatory; the advisor must sign or affix a seal.
On the Relinquishment Form, students must tick 'Not completing' (미수료) for the question on completion this semester.
Students who submit a Continuation Form must meet the eligibility requirements for, and take, the doctoral qualifying examination at the beginning of the third semester.
A student who fails the doctoral qualifying examination then submits a Relinquishment Form and graduates from the master's program.

In principle only one attempt at the doctoral qualifying examination is given; after a failure, a petition signed by the advisor may be submitted, and the Academic Affairs Committee decides whether to grant one more attempt in the following semester.

After a failure, a retake in the following semester is possible up to a maximum of two times, only if the advisor submits a petition demonstrating the student's excellence to the Academic Affairs Committee in that semester and it passes review.
If the committee rejects the petition even once, no further retake is allowed.

Relinquishment (master's degree only): On the form, for 'Completion this semester' (이번학기 수료 여부), tick 'Not completing' (미수료).
Relinquishment (master's degree only): Sign the form yourself (mandatory) and obtain your advisor's signature or seal.
Relinquishment (master's degree only): Submit the form to the staff member at the department office, Building 301, Room 319.
Continuation (staying in the integrated program): Download and print the attached Continuation Form (석박사통합과정 지속원.hwp).

Continuation (staying in the integrated program): Submit the form to the staff member at the department office, Building 301, Room 319.
translation:
Fall 2026: Submission of Relinquishment/Continuation Forms for Integrated Master's-Doctoral Program Students

1. Who must submit
- Students in the integrated master's-doctoral program for whom Fall 2026 (2026-2) is their second semester (for example, students admitted in March 2026).

2. Submission deadline
- From 15 September 2026 to 17:00 on 11 December 2026.
- Integrated program students in their fourth semester or later who wish to complete the master's program in February 2027 must submit a Relinquishment Form (포기원) by the morning of 23 September 2026.

3. How to apply
1) Relinquishment Form (if you wish to receive only a master's degree)
MySNU > Student Services (학생서비스) > Academic Status Changes (학적변동) > Apply (신청) > Major/Program Cancellation Application (전공/과정취소신청) > Withdrawal from Integrated Master's-Doctoral Program (석박사통합포기) > print the application form > for 'Completion this semester' (이번학기 수료 여부), tick 'Not completing' (미수료) > your own signature (mandatory) > advisor's signature (or seal) > submit to the staff member at the department office (Building 301, Room 319).
2) Continuation Form (if you wish to continue in the integrated master's-doctoral program)
Download and print the attachment (Continuation Form, 지속원) > your own signature (mandatory) > advisor's signature (or seal) > submit to the staff member at the department office (Building 301, Room 319).

4. Important notes
- Integrated program students admitted in 2015 or later must take the qualifying examination for thesis submission in their third semester, so they must submit a Relinquishment or Continuation Form in their second semester (for example, students admitted in March 2026).
- If you wish to complete the master's program, please submit the Relinquishment Form no later than the semester immediately before the semester in which you wish to complete, so that no problems arise with your academic record.
- Students (of earlier admission years) who have already submitted a Continuation Form but wish to receive only a master's degree should submit a Relinquishment Form according to the schedule above.
- Submitting a Relinquishment Form changes your academic status to the master's program, so changing back to the integrated master's-doctoral program later is not possible! → Related notice (link; its content was not included in this notice and has not been read).

(Reference) Qualifying examination for thesis submission
- If you submit a Continuation Form, you must meet the eligibility requirements for the doctoral qualifying examination at the beginning of your third semester and take the examination. If you fail the doctoral qualifying examination, you will then submit a Relinquishment Form and graduate from the master's program. However, in principle only one attempt at the doctoral qualifying examination is given; if, after failing, you submit a petition signed by your advisor, the Academic Affairs Committee will discuss whether to give you one more attempt in the following semester and decide whether to grant an additional attempt. In case of failure, a retake in the following semester is possible up to a maximum of two times, on the condition that the advisor submits to the Academic Affairs Committee, in that semester, a petition demonstrating the student's excellence and that the petition passes review; however, if the petition is rejected in review even once, no retake is possible. → Related notice (link; its content was not included in this notice and has not been read).

- Contact: Department office (Building 301, Room 319). The staff member's contact details are given in the original notice.
